name: Kimbark Street
source:
Wred, California, 1949

In the depths of the northern Sierra Nevada mountains lies the town of Wred, California. Touted as a "pioneer town", the intricate brick work lays upons the rotten wood of the 1800s. An influx of new residents has made the city a promising new outpost for an influx and boom in American culture. 

On March 1st, 1949, John Freeman killed two men and buried their bodies in the woods two miles out from Kimbark street. 

And now he just needs to wait for the evidence to rot.

[From [url=https://aspenglen.itch.io/kimbark-street]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1949年，加利福尼亚州Wred镇。

在内华达山脉北部深处，坐落着加州的Wred镇。这里号称“拓荒者之镇”，精巧的砖砌建筑下，却是19世纪留下的腐朽木料。新居民不断涌入，让这座城镇有望成为美国文化蓬勃发展的一处新据点。

1949年3月1日，John Freeman杀死了两名男子，把尸体埋在距离Kimbark街两英里的树林里。

现在，他只需要等证据慢慢腐烂。
